sentence_stem: When I lived in the village, I used to
correct_completion: wake up early to help my grandfather.
full_sentence: When I lived in the village, I used to wake up early to help my grandfather.
acceptable_variants: get up at dawn to feed the animals.
help my grandfather in the fields every morning.

options.text: waking up early to help my grandfather.
options.why_wrong: After 'used to' the verb must be in the base form, not the -ing form.

options.text: to wake up early to help my grandfather.
options.why_wrong: 'Used to' is followed directly by the base verb, so 'to' must not be repeated.

options.text: I have woken up early to help my grandfather.
options.why_wrong: 'Used to' is not followed by a present perfect auxiliary; adding 'have' breaks the structure.

options.text: wake up early to help my grandfather.

grammar_focus: Used to + base verb for past habits
explanation: The structure 'used to' is followed by the base form of the verb to describe a past habit that no longer continues. Learners often add an extra word or an -ing form after it, which is incorrect.
translation: Коли я жив у селі, я мав звичку рано прокидатися, щоб допомагати дідусеві.
